summary: Rachel Kim called HomeNet because her installation was scheduled for yesterday but did not occur. The agent confirmed that there were no access issues to the property and offered to reschedule the appointment to Thursday, with a credit applied to her next bill as compensation for lost time.  The call concluded with Rachel agreeing to this new arrangement.
